cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Make Help Define Us
cards.instruction: Get their help, then use how it is offered to redefine what the relationship means.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Take the far end of my table. Today I'm promoting you from rescuer to partner.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm stronger. I can carry it on my own.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: No, you'll leave this end to me. A partner trusts me with something heavy.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: All right. Where do you want us to put it?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: That's the question I wanted. Stay there while I clear the corner; then we'll choose the angle together.

reason: Make A direct the lift and explicitly interpret B shift from rescuing to consulting as partnership, while holding control of order rather than attaching status to a plea.
